I am deeply grateful to my advisor, Prof. Carlos Maquera, for all the advice and useful insight provided dur
arxiv-2202-07622.creator: Douglas Finamore
arxiv-2202-07622.description: Abstract . We consider contact foliations: objects which generalise to higher dimensions the flow of the Reeb vector field on contact manifolds. We list several properties of such foliations and propose two conjectures about the topological types of their leaves, both of which coincide with the classical Weinstein conjecture in the case of contact flows.

arxiv-2204-07318.title: An ab initio study of structural phase transitions of crystalline aluminum under ultrahigh pressures based on ensemble theory
arxiv-2204-07318.creator: Bo-Yuan Ning, Li-Yuan Zhang
arxiv-2204-07318.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Bo-Yuan Ning, Li-Yuan Zhang. It is a long-time pursuit of computations with ab initio precision of thermal contributions to phase behaviors of condensed matters under extreme conditions. In this work, the pressure induced structural phase transitions of crystalline aluminum up to 600 600 GPa at room temperature are investigated based on the criterion of Gibbs free energy derived directly from the partition function that formulated in the ensemble theory with the interatomic interactions characterized by density functional theory computations.

arxiv-2211-08577.title: DCT Perceptron Layer: A Transform Domain Approach for Convolution Layer
arxiv-2211-08577.creator: Hongyi Pan, Xin Zhu, Salih Atici, Ahmet Enis Cetin, Department of Electrical, Computer Engineering
arxiv-2211-08577.description: Abstract In this paper, we propose a novel Discrete Cosine Transform (DCT)-based neural network layer which we call DCT-perceptron to replace the 3 × 3 3\times 3 Conv2D layers in the Residual neural Network (ResNet). Convolutional filtering operations are performed in the DCT domain using element-wise multiplications by taking advantage of the Fourier and DCT Convolution theorems.

arxiv-2308-09775.title: Long-range Multimodal Pretraining for Movie Understanding
arxiv-2308-09775.creator: Dawit Mureja Argaw, Joon-Young Lee, Markus Woodson, In So Kweon, Fabian Caba Heilbron
arxiv-2308-09775.description: Abstract Learning computer vision models from (and for) movies has a long-standing history. While great progress has been attained, there is still a need for a pretrained multimodal model that can perform well in the ever-growing set of movie understanding tasks the community has been establishing.

arxiv-2502-07610.title: Assessment of non-intrusive sensing in wall-bounded turbulence through explainable deep learning
arxiv-2502-07610.creator: A. Cremades 1, R. Freibergs 1, S. Hoyas 2, A. Ianiro 3, S. Discetti 3, R. Vinuesa 1
arxiv-2502-07610.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by A. Cremades 1, R. Freibergs 1, S. Hoyas 2, A. Ianiro 3, S. Discetti 3, R. Vinuesa 1. In this work we present a framework to explain the prediction of the velocity fluctuation at a certain wall-normal distance from wall measurements with a deep-learning model. For this purpose, we apply the deep-SHAP method to explain the velocity fluctuation prediction in wall-parallel planes in a turbulent open channel at a friction Reynolds number Re τ = 180 {\rm{Re}}_{\tau}=180 . The explainable-deep-learning methodology comprises two stages.

arxiv-2506-13707.title: Dimer-projection contact and the clock shift of a unitary Fermi gas
arxiv-2506-13707.creator: Kevin G. S. Xie, Colin J. Dale, Kiera Pond Grehan, Maggie Fen Wang, Tilman Enss, Paul S. Julienne, Zhenhua Yu, Joseph H. Thywissen
arxiv-2506-13707.description: Abstract The time evolution of the contact parameter provides key insights into correlation dynamics in ultracold gases. However, most contact measurements to date have focused on equilibrium systems or slow, global dynamics. Here, we demonstrate that projecting a unitary Fermi gas onto a low-lying dimer state enables rapid probing of the contact.

arxiv-2508-13680.title: ViExam: Are Vision Language Models Better than Humans on Vietnamese Multimodal Exam Questions?
arxiv-2508-13680.creator: Vy Tuong Dang, An Vo, Quang Tau, Duc Dm, Daeyoung Kim
arxiv-2508-13680.description: Abstract Vision language models (VLMs) demonstrate remarkable capabilities on English multimodal tasks, but their performance on low-resource languages with genuinely multimodal educational content remains largely unexplored. In this work, we test how VLMs perform on Vietnamese educational assessments, investigating whether VLMs trained predominantly on English data can handle real-world cross-lingual multimodal reasoning.

arxiv-2510-13153.title: Dependency of the Bar Formation Timescale On The Halo Spin
arxiv-2510-13153.creator: Bin-Hui Chen, Sandeep Kumar Kataria, Juntai Shen, Meng Guo
arxiv-2510-13153.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Bin-Hui Chen, Sandeep Kumar Kataria, Juntai Shen, Meng Guo. Bars are among the most prominent structures in disk galaxies. While the widely accepted swing-amplification theory provides a qualitative framework for their formation, the detailed physical processes remain incompletely understood. Previous studies have shown that the bar formation timescale in isolated galaxies depends exponentially on the disk mass fraction (the so-called “Fujii relation”) and linearly on disk hotness and thickness.

arxiv-2511-01098.title: Epanechnikov nonparametric kernel density estimation based feature-learning in respiratory disease chest X-ray images
arxiv-2511-01098.creator: Verónica Marsico, Antonio Quintero-Rincón, Hadj Batatia, To cite this work, please use this reference
arxiv-2511-01098.description: Abstract This study presents a novel method for diagnosing respiratory diseases using image data. It combines Epanechnikov’s non-parametric kernel density estimation (EKDE) with a bimodal logistic regression classifier in a statistical-model-based learning scheme. EKDE’s flexibility in modeling data distributions without assuming specific shapes and its adaptability to pixel intensity variations make it valuable for extracting key features from medical images.

arxiv-2511-17800.title: Broadband X-ray observations of the periodic optical source ZTF J185139.81+171430.3 and its identification as a massive intermediate polar
arxiv-2511-17800.creator: Ren Deng, Kaya Mori, Eric Miao, Gabriel Bridges, Charles J. Hailey, David A. H. Buckley, Gavin Ramsay, Dan Jarvis
arxiv-2511-17800.description: Abstract We present X-ray observations of the periodic optical source ZTF J185139.81+171430.3 (hereafter ZTF J1851) by the XMM-Newton , NICER and NuSTAR telescopes. The source was initially speculated to be a white dwarf (WD) pulsar system due to its short period ( P ∼ 12 P\sim 12 min) and highly-modulated optical lightcurves.

arxiv-2511-18926.title: MoodBench 1.0: An Evaluation Benchmark for Emotional Companionship Dialogue Systems
arxiv-2511-18926.creator: Haifeng Jing, Yujie Hou, Junfei Liu, Rui Xie, alan Xu, Jinlong Ma, Qichun Deng
arxiv-2511-18926.description: Abstract . With the rapid development of Large Language Models, dialogue systems are shifting from information tools to emotional companions, heralding the era of Emotional Companionship Dialogue Systems (ECDs) that provide personalized emotional support for users. However, the field lacks clear definitions and systematic evaluation standards for ECDs.

arxiv-2511-19994.title: A Focused Review of Quintom Cosmology: From Quintom Dark Energy to Quintom Bounce
arxiv-2511-19994.creator: Tao-tao Qiu, Yifu Cai, Yang Liu, Si-Yu Li, Jarah Evslin, Xinmin Zhang
arxiv-2511-19994.description: Abstract The recently released data of DESI DR2 favors a dynamical dark energy theory, with the equation of state crossing the cosmological constant boundary w = − 1 w=-1 . In this paper, we briefly review quintom cosmology, especially the quintom bounce.

openalex-w7214168215.description: O artigo analisa como o PISA 2025 participa da definição de necessidades educacionais associadas ao estudante “preparado para o futuro”, à luz da educação como política social. A pesquisa é qualitativa, documental e crítico-interpretativa e examina duas publicações oficiais da...

plos-pone-0001516.creator: Stijn P. De Langhe, Gianni Carraro, Denise Tefft et al.
plos-pone-0001516.description: PLOS ONE research article. The role of ß-catenin signaling in mesodermal lineage formation and differentiation has been elusive. To define the role of ß-catenin signaling in these processes, we used a Dermo1 ( Twist2 ) Cre/+ line to target a floxed β-catenin allele, throughout the embryonic mesenchyme. Str

pmc-10636624.title: A Hybrid Decision Tree and Deep Learning Approach Combining Medical Imaging and Electronic Medical Records to Predict Intubation Among Hospitalized Patients With COVID-19: Algorithm Development and Validation
pmc-10636624.creator: Kim-Anh-Nhi Nguyen, Pranai Tandon, Sahar Ghanavati, Satya Narayana Cheetirala, Prem Timsina, Robert Freeman, David Reich, Matthew A Levin, Madhu Mazumdar, Zahi A Fayad, Arash Kia
pmc-10636624.description: BackgroundEarly prediction of the need for invasive mechanical ventilation (IMV) in patients hospitalized with COVID-19 symptoms can help in the allocation of resources appropriately and improve patient outcomes by appropriately monitoring and treating patients at the greatest risk of respiratory failure.

pmc-11674076.title: The Cellular and Transcriptomic Early Innate Immune Response to BCG Vaccination in Mice
pmc-11674076.creator: Liya G Kondratyeva, Olga A Rakitina, Victor V Pleshkan, Alexey I Kuzmich, Irina A Linge, Sofia A Kondratieva, Eugene V Snezhkov, Irina V Alekseenko, Eugene D Sverdlov, Stefanie Steiger
pmc-11674076.description: It is established that BCG vaccination results in the development of both a specific immune response to mycobacterial infections and a nonspecific (heterologous) immune response, designated as trained immunity (TRIM), to other pathogens. We hypothesized that local BCG immunization may induce an early immune response in bone marrow and spleen innate immunity cells.

pmc-12401565.title: Influence of OSCAR-IB Criteria on Test-Retest Reliability of Cirrus HD-OCT Retinal Thickness Measurements in People With Multiple Sclerosis
pmc-12401565.creator: Anna Bacchetti, Ting-Yi Lin, Brenna McCormack, Omar Ezzedin, Rozita Doosti, Gelareh Ahmadi, Nicole Pellegrini, Evan Johnson, Simidele Davis, Elle Lawrence, Gabriel Otero-Duran, Ernest Lievers, Madeline Inserra, Sooyeon Park, Devon Bonair, Anna Kim, Ananya Gulati, Kathryn C. Fitzgerald, Elias S. Soti
pmc-12401565.description: Background and ObjectivesOptical coherence tomography (OCT) allows evaluation of inter-eye differences (IEDs) in macular ganglion cell-inner plexiform layer (GCIPL) and peripapillary retinal nerve fiber layer (pRNFL) thicknesses to identify unilateral optic nerve involvement (UONI). UONI supports dissemination in space (DIS) as part of the 2024 revised McDonald diagnostic criteria for multiple sclerosis (MS).

pmc-12634329.title: A randomized controlled trial of Shengji ointment combined with bromelain in promoting healing of tendon-exposed diabetic foot wounds: integrated 16S rDNA sequencing and metabolomics analysis
pmc-12634329.creator: Xu Sun, Jielin Song, Junchao Sun, Zhaohui Zhang
pmc-12634329.description: BackgroundDiabetic foot tendon exposures are prone to infection, necrosis, and prolonged treatment cycle, not only hinder wound healing, but may also lead to amputation and even life-threatening. Utilizing Shengji ointment (a Traditional Chinese Medicine, TCM) combined with bromelain for treating diabetic foot tendon exposure wounds has demonstrated preliminary efficacy.

pmc-12649875.title: Rapid On-Site Detection of Pseudomonas aeruginosa via ecfX-Targeted Loop-Mediated Isothermal Amplification
pmc-12649875.creator: Xuliang He, Meimei Zeng, Wentao Bai, Ziyan Tang, Jianhua Ding, Zhu Chen
pmc-12649875.description: Pseudomonas aeruginosa (PA) is a significant pathogen of clinical concern that is frequently associated with multidrug resistance, leading to respiratory tract, wound, and hospital-acquired infections. To enable rapid and accurate detection, we developed a fluorescence-based loop-mediated isothermal amplification (LAMP) method, targeting the PA-specific ecfX gene.

pmc-12658288.title: Intrasubject Gait Variability During Stair Walking in Knee Osteoarthritis: A Kinematic and Kinetic Analysis
pmc-12658288.creator: Ye Ma, Shixin Lin, Yaqi Mao, Chenyi Guo, Dongwei Liu, Meijin Hou
pmc-12658288.description: BackgroundGait variability in kinematic and kinetic parameters during stair walking is a key indicator of motor function and fall risk in individuals with knee osteoarthritis (KOA). However, normative reference data and pathological patterns in KOA remain under explored.MethodsThis cross‐sectional study analyzed retrospective data from 169 participants, including 116 individuals with KOA and 53 matched healthy controls.

pmc-12978175.title: Group-based trajectory modeling for declines in hepatitis B surface antigen over time accurately identifies chronic hepatitis B patients achieving functional cure: a single-center cohort study in China
pmc-12978175.creator: Yuchen Peng, Liping Liu, Xiaoping Wu
pmc-12978175.description: BackgroundIdentifying chronic hepatitis B (CHB) patients likely to achieve hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg) sero-clearance upon receiving pegylated interferon α (PEG-IFNα) could aid in optimizing treatment strategies for “functional cure”.AimsTo develop a group-based trajectory model (GBTM) for identifying PEG-IFNα-treated CHB patients likely to achieve HBsAg sero-clearance.

pmc-13002499.title: Optimizing ADAMTS13 prophylaxis to reduce relapse and organ failure in congenital thrombotic thrombocytopenic purpura∗
pmc-13002499.creator: Bérangère S Joly, Adrien Joseph, Raïda Bouzid, Pierre Boisseau, Thérésa Kwon, Claire Dossier, Nathalie Gouge-Biebuyck, Olivia Boyer, Vassilis Tsatsaris, Jérôme Harambat, Yahsou Delmas, Olivier Moranne, Anne-Laure Sellier-Leclerc, Manon Marie, Christelle Barbet, François Provôt, Ygal Benhamou, Agnès

Introduction Congenital thrombotic thrombocytopenic purpura (cTTP; Upshaw-Schulman syndrome; Online Mendelian Inheritance in Man, 274150) is a rare autosomal recessive disorder, with a prevalence of 0.

pmc-13071552.title: When Pathways Converge: Iron, Lipid Peroxidation, and α‐Synuclein in Ferroptosis‐Driven Dopaminergic Neurodegeneration
pmc-13071552.creator: Carmem L. Sperlich, Brent R. Stockwell, Marcelo Farina
pmc-13071552.description: The selective degeneration of dopaminergic neurons is a hallmark of Parkinson's disease and related disorders. While multiple cell death pathways have been implicated, ferroptosis has recently emerged as a critical mechanism. This iron‐dependent form of regulated cell death is driven by the accumulation of phospholipid hydroperoxides, leading to oxidative membrane damage.

pmc-13166986.title: Sciatic and Posterior Femoral Cutaneous Nerve Anomalies and Their Clinical Implications for Sciatica and Piriformis Syndrome: A Cadaveric Case Report
pmc-13166986.creator: Camille Reaux, Sara G Teel, Nicholas C Heppner-Lundin, Zachary Norrod, Ahmad Imam, Kamal A Abouzaid
pmc-13166986.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). The sciatic nerve (SN), the largest nerve in the human body, normally exits the pelvis inferior to the piriformis muscle (PM) before dividing into its two terminal branches, the tibial nerve (TN) and the common fibular nerve (CFN). Variations in the anatomy of the SN and the posterior femoral cutaneous nerve (PFCN) may occur during embryologic development and can have important clinical implications, including piriformis syndrome, sciatica, and increased susceptibility to iatrogenic injury.

pmc-13177878.title: A portrait of commissioned literature: connecting the dots between medical education and communication companies, authors, funders and publishers
pmc-13177878.creator: Maud Bernisson
pmc-13177878.description: BackgroundMedical education and communication companies (MECCs) are key actors in the production of commissioned publications. Analyzing publications that acknowledge medical writing offers a broad overview of their role, which is scarce in the literature. The reason is that activities related to industry-funded research are highly opaque, which makes access to this information particularly hard, and related analyses scarce.

pmc-13331456.title: Three Empty Bottles and a Wide QRS: Rapid Alkalinization Rescue in Propafenone Overdose
pmc-13331456.creator: Afnan Chaudhry, Ibrahim Inanc, Saad Khan, George Prousi, Shilla Zachariah

pmc-13355933.title: TET1 Inhibition Promotes Therapeutic Sensitivity in TP53‐Mutant GBM by Influencing Genome Fragility and Altering TAMs Biology
pmc-13355933.creator: Zhuonan Pu, Jinqiu Liu, Yuxuan Deng, Shuyu Hao, Xiaoli Zhang, Mingxu Yang, Chao Guo, Chao Du, Yingdan Chen, Tai Sun, Nan Ji, Zhengping Zhuang, Jie Feng
pmc-13355933.description: TP53 mutations (TP53mut) are associated with therapeutic resistance in glioblastoma (GBM) patients, yet the underlying mechanisms remain incompletely understood. Here, we identified an association between reduced P53 function and increased expression of the epigenetic regulator TET1 in GBM models. In TP53mut GBM cells, TET1 knockdown influenced genome fragility, including DNA damage, senescence, and telomere shortening.

pmc-13409490.title: Self-Extinguishing Alginate-Based Xerogel Foams for Thermal Insulation
pmc-13409490.creator: Radmila Damjanović, Marija M. Vuksanović, Milena Stavrić, Jovana Ružić, Irena Živković, Radmila Jančić Heinemann
pmc-13409490.description: Biopolymer-based porous materials are attracting increasing interest as sustainable alternatives to conventional thermal insulation foams; however, achieving low thermal conductivity together with adequate mechanical performance and fire response remains challenging. Building on previous formulation screening, this study investigates alginate-expanded perlite xerogel foams modified with chitosan and glycerol for thermal insulation applications.

pmc-13457404.title: Engineered Nature‐Based Sonosensitizer for Broad‐Spectrum Infectious Tissue Repair via Sono‐Ionic Therapy
pmc-13457404.creator: Liang Ma, Hongchuan Wang, Weidong Liang, Tao Xu, Jie Lei, Li Zhang, Shutao Gao, Xiaoyu Cai, Qian Li, Wenzhao Wang, Chuanhui Xun, Weibin Sheng, Cao Yang, Yingsong Wang
pmc-13457404.description: Repairing infectious tissues, particularly bone and wound infections, poses significant challenges to clinicians due to the lack of effective treatment modalities. Sonodynamic therapy, which utilizes sonosensitizers to generate reactive oxygen species (ROS) under ultrasound (US) energy for antibacterial purposes, still lacks suitable sonosensitizers with good biocompatibility that can simultaneously promote the repair of various infected tissues.

pmc-13462307.title: Prevalence of Autism Spectrum Disorders and the Years Lived With Disability in Eastern Sub‐Saharan Africa, From 1990 to 2023
pmc-13462307.creator: Sebsibe Tadesse, Boko Loka Safayi, Abdulbasit Sherfa, Musa Jemal, Begetayinoral Kussia Lahole, Melese Chego Cheme, Sewhareg Belay, Asqual Gebreslassie Gebremariam, Gemechis Tuke, Abinet Zewudie, Gelgelo Wodessa, Geleta Nenko Dube

pmc-13474700.title: The impact of preoperative sleep disorders on postoperative pain and recovery in patients undergoing gastrectomy: a prospective cohort study
pmc-13474700.creator: Wenzhi Zhu, Shuxia Li, Yan Huang, Xiaoyi Wang, Hongyu Tan
pmc-13474700.description: BackgroundPoor sleep quality is a common comorbidity in surgical patients, but its specific impact on postoperative outcomes in gastric cancer surgery remains underexplored. This study investigated the association of preoperative sleep disorders on pain sensitivity, analgesic consumption, and recovery in this population.

pmc-13479426.title: Changes in eating disorder symptoms and influential factors among Chinese college students: a four-wave longitudinal study
pmc-13479426.creator: Mingze Sun, Jiaojian Dai, Yukai Li, Sijie Zhu, Chenjing Wu, Dongfang Wang

pmc-13665502.title: Spiritual Well-Being, Treatment Adherence, and Self-Management in Hemodialysis Care: A Cross-Sectional Study
pmc-13665502.creator: Handan Özdemir, Sıddıka Ersoy
pmc-13665502.description: Background/Objectives: Hemodialysis requires sustained patient participation in demanding treatment and self-management routines. Spiritual well-being may be a patient-centered psychosocial resource relevant to adherence and self-management, but its independent associations with these patient-reported outcomes remain uncertain. This study examined the associations of spiritual well-being with treatment adherence and self-management among adults undergoing hemodialysis.
